verdict.rationale: Clerk's marketing material says it handles the full session lifecycle, including active device monitoring and session revocation. Its user profile UI shows a per-device "Sign out of device" action, and the profile component covers security settings. That covers the end-user half of the story: viewing devices and revoking them one at a time. Missing for 10: evidence of admin-side session and device visibility and revocation (Dashboard or Backend API), a revoke-all/sign-out-everywhere capability, in-depth first-party session-management docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
